senses.gloss: ch. sameto be white, to shine.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joel 1:7">Targ. Joel I, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 49:12">Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 12</cite> <he>יְחִוְּרַן</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Lsb. <he>יַחְוְרָן</he>, oth. ed. <he>יְחַוְּ׳</he>).
Targ. Is. I, 18 (some ed. Pa.); a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 61b:1">Keth. 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>דחֲוַור אפיה</he> that he looked pale.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 69a:6">B. Kam. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דנִיחֲוַור טפי</he> that it may appear still more white (glistening from a distance).
<cite ref="Nazir 39a">Naz. 39ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>חַוְורִין עיקבי נימהון</he> the lower ends of dyed hair are white (which proves that the growth comes from beneath); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (of eyes) to be bright, to look with gratification.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:33">Targ. Prov. XXIII, 33</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:24">Ib. XVII, 24</cite> <he>חָיְירָן</he> Ms. (ed. <he>חדיין</he>, v. <cite ref="H00190"><he>חדי</he></cite>). [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 4:25">Ib. IV, 25</cite>, emend. by Luzzatto Oheb Ger p. 108, v., however, <cite ref="A00841"><he>אוֹר</he></cite> I ch.]—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 39a:11">Kidd. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>לא חַוְורִיתוּ</he> you do not see clearly (the law is not clear to you).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 19:25">Targ. II Sam. XIX, 25</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:6">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>חַוְּורֵיה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D01012"><he>דְּקַן</he></cite>.
Ḥull. 95ᵇ top מְחַוֵּור, v. חֲלַל II. [Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ bot. מרוח, read מְחַוֵּר or מִחְוַר to wash.]—Part. pass. מְחַוַּור, f. מְחַוְּוָרא blanched.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 4:6">Targ. Y. Ex. IV, 6</cite>.
Gen. R. s. 27 דמְחַוֵּור וכ׳ which will prove it better; Yalk. Koh. 968.—מְחַוַּורְתָּא it is proven, obvious.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85b:6">B. Kam. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ואַחְוְורֵיה לבשריה</he> and it (the corrodent) made his skin look white (like a leper’s; Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:12">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>באַחְוְורֵי אפי</he> (they guard against) whitening faces (putting persons to shame); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 349">Yalk. Ex. 349</cite>.
